description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.Data Center Manager for the world’s biggest Cloud Infrastructure.

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. description:
Do you want to own the hard technical problems behind planning at scale? The Under the Roof Labor Planning Technology (UTRPT) team is hiring a Software Development Engineer III to design and scale the systems that power labor planning across Amazon's fulfillment, delivery, and operations networks. Our services influence how hundreds of thousands of associates are planned for every day — generating capacity predictions, scheduling recommendations, and planning signals that operators depend on.

This is a role for someone who wants breadth and ownership: design and scale distributed backend services, lead through technical influence across teams, and integrate machine learning and data-driven systems into production. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and operations research, partnering with Science and Data Engineering to bring AI-driven planning models into reliable, scalable production. You'll have the autonomy to shape solutions end to end and set technical direction that the organization builds on.

Key job responsibilities
Own the design and delivery of complex, distributed backend services at the center of UTRPT's roadmap, making architecture decisions that scale cleanly across new business lines and geographies
Partner with Science and Data Engineering teams to productionize machine learning models and data pipelines, ensuring reliability and operational excellence in production systems
Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, code reviews, and testing strategy — raising the bar for how the team builds and setting best practices others follow
Lead cross-team technical initiatives that resolve ambiguity into shippable plans, breaking down problems with multiple risks and roadblocks into incremental deliveries
Mentor engineers toward senior-level ownership through technical guidance, operational best practices, and by modeling how to balance short-term delivery with long-term architecture

A day in the life
You lead a design discussion on a new planning service, weighing trade-offs across reliability, latency, and cost. You review a teammate's design and unblock them with guidance on extending existing solutions. You partner with Science to productionize a model integration, ensuring the right operational practices are in place. You pair with a junior engineer on a code review, helping them see the bigger picture. Using AI-native development tools, you make progress on a system you own end to end, and you carve out time to remove a piece of systemic friction slowing the team down.

About the team
The Under the Roof Labor Planning Technology (UTRPT) organization builds the software systems that power labor planning across Amazon's fulfillment, delivery, and operations networks. Our services influence how hundreds of thousands of associates are planned for every day — generating recommendations, capacity predictions, and planning signals that operators and planners depend on. We work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and operations research, partnering closely with Science and Data Engineering to bring planning models into production.

We value engineering rigor, operational ownership, and continuous improvement. We're in the middle of a multi-year effort to consolidate and scale our platform across new business lines and geographies. The team embraces AI-native development practices, offers regular cross-team collaboration, and provides high-ownership opportunities for engineers ready to lead through technical influence and shape how we build the future of labor planning at Amazon.

description:
FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable
Amazon Financial Operations | Level 5 | Full-Time | US Shift


Every payment Amazon makes to a supplier starts with a promise - and the Accounts Payable Operations team is the engine that keeps that promise, at massive scale, across dozens of subsidiaries and global marketplaces. As a FinOps Manager – AP, you’ll lead a core US-shift team responsible for the full invoice lifecycle - from ingestion through successful payment execution - ensuring that tens of thousands of vendors worldwide are paid accurately and on time.

This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of operational excellence and financial transformation. You’ll own the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into a centralized operating model, build the playbooks that scale our operations for Amazon’s continued expansion, and drive automation initiatives that directly reduce manual touchpoints and cost-per-transaction. If you’re energized by building teams, simplifying complexity, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-moving environment - this role was made for you.

Role Overview

The FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable will lead a team supporting core US-shift AP operations and play a critical role in ensuring financial operations are scalable, efficient, and prepared for continued business growth.

The role will have end-to-end ownership of the Accounts Payable process, from invoice ingestion through invoice processing, exception/hold resolution, and successful payment execution. The manager will work closely with upstream and downstream teams across Finance, Procurement, Technology, and business functions to ensure timely and accurate processing and payments.

The role will also be responsible for transitioning and stabilizing AP processes for multiple subsidiaries. This includes building and developing high-performing teams, managing operational performance, establishing priorities, driving process improvements, and ensuring compliance with global policies, controls, and service-level commitments.
The successful candidate will be a strong people leader and operational owner with a passion for process innovation, automation, controllership, and customer/vendor experience. The candidate should be comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and independently solving complex and ambiguous business problems.


Basic Qualifications

1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 10+ years of post-qualification experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or a related field.

2. 5+ years of project management and people management experience, including experience leading cross-functional initiatives with technical and non-technical teams.

3. Strong understanding of Accounts Payable operations and end-to-end financial processes.

4. Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale operations, transitions, and process changes.

5. Strong customer focus with experience managing internal and external stakeholders.

6. Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.

7. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

8. Results-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to delive
r against challenging goals.

9. Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

10. Ability and willingness to work in flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.




Preferred Qualifications

1. 4+ years of experience driving continuous improvement initiatives that improved controllership, operational efficiency, or scalability with measurable results.

2. 4+ years of experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, performing root-cause analysis, and developing and implementing escalation/corrective-action plans.

3. 4+ years of experience mentoring and developing junior finance, operations, or business team members.

4. Experience managing global or multi-geography Accounts Payable operations.

5. Experience with process transitions, migrations, or integration of new subsidiaries.

6. Experience working with automation, workflow, self-service, or finance technology solutions.

7. Experience developing operational metrics and using data to drive business decisions.




Key job responsibilities
1. Lead, manage, and develop a team of AP Specialists and Operations Managers supporting end-to-end Accounts Payable operations.

2. Own day-to-day operational performance and ensure accuracy, timeliness, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.

3. Successfully lead the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into the operations team, ensuring smooth migration, stabilization, and business continuity.

4. Manage hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and career development for team members.

5. Establish team priorities, allocate workload effectively, and ensure appropriate resource planning based on business requirements and volume forecasts.

6. Drive systems, process, and operational improvements to enable on-time and accurate vendor payments.

7. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through automation, standardization, and self-service solutions.

8. Own and drive adherence to AP policies, procedures, and controls while ensuring consistency across global entities.

9. Act as a senior escalation point for complex vendor, customer, payment, invoice, and operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate stakeholder communication.

10. Proactively identify recurring issues, analyze service trends, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

11. Develop, maintain, and monitor operational metrics and dashboards covering SLA performance, payment timeliness, productivity, quality, defects, backlog, cost, and customer/vendor experience.

12. Drive cost optimization initiatives and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and scalability.

13. Partner with Finance leadership to forecast future headcount requirements based on business growth, transaction volumes, country expansion, and operational demand.

14. Expand self-service capabilities and digital solutions to improve the vendor experience while reducing manual intervention.

15. Provide regular weekly and monthly business reviews, performance updates, and operational insights to Director- and VP-level Finance stakeholders.

16. Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls across AP processes.

17. Partner with Internal Audit, controllership, compliance, and finance teams to address control gaps and audit requirements.

18. Lead cross-functional technology, systems, and process-improvement initiatives involving Finance, Procurement, Operations, and technical teams.

20. Work effectively with stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, including support for US business hours, flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.

21. Ensure operational readiness for new business launches, subsidiary transitions, process changes, and organizational growth.


How you’ll spend your time: Expect roughly 40% leading and coaching your team, 25% on cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication, 20% on process improvement and automation projects, and 15% on deep-focus analysis (metrics, controls, forecasting).


People Leadership

The manager will be responsible for building and maintaining a high-performing AP organization by:

a) Hiring and developing strong finance and operations talent.
b) Establishing clear performance expectations and measurable goals.
c) Conducting regular performance reviews and providing actionable feedback.
d) Identifying development opportunities and creating career progression plans for team members.
e) Coaching employees to improve operational, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
f) Building a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, customer obsession, and operational excellence.

Process & Operational Excellence

a) The role requires a strong focus on continuously improving AP operations by:
b) Identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and recurring defects.
c) Performing root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.
d) Standardizing processes across subsidiaries and geographies.
e) Reducing manual effort through automation and self-service.
f) Improving payment accuracy and timeliness.
g) Driving measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, and customer/vendor experience.
h) Establishing mechanisms to monitor and prevent negative service trends.


Stakeholder Management
a) The candidate will work extensively with Finance, Procurement, Controllership, Internal Audit, Technology, Operations, and external vendors across multiple geographies.
b) The role requires the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, influence decisions, manage escalations, and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.



A day in the life
What This Role Offers You

You’ll have a front-row seat to Amazon’s financial infrastructure at global scale - leading a team that directly impacts supplier relationships, cash management, and controllership across every marketplace Amazon operates in. This is not a maintain-the-status-quo role: you’ll build new operating models, drive automation, and shape the future of how Amazon pays its partners.


Key Performance Areas

Success in this role will be measured through:

i. Operational Excellence – Accuracy, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
ii. Payment Performance – Timely and accurate vendor payments.
iii. People Leadership – Team engagement, performance, retention, and career development.
iv. Process Improvement – Automation, standardization, and measurable efficiency gains.
v. Customer/Vendor Experience – Effective resolution of issues and improvement in service levels.
vi. Controllership & Compliance – Strong internal controls and audit readiness.
vii. Cost Optimization – Productivity improvements and effective resource utilization.
viii. Business Growth & Scalability – Readiness to support new subsidiaries, geographies, volumes, and business requirements.


About the team
About the Team

Accounts Payable Operations supports multiple geographies and marketplaces globally and provides critical financial services across the organization.

The team is responsible for:

1. Manual and automated invoice processing.
2. Invoice ingestion and validation.
3. Resolution of invoice holds and exceptions.
4. Ensuring timely and accurate supplier payments.
5. Vendor account setup and maintenance.
6. Responding to supplier and business partner queries.
7. Supporting subsidiary transitions and process migrations.
8. Driving automation and process improvements across AP operations.


The team operates in a highly dynamic environment and partners with multiple global stakeholders to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payments to suppliers while continuously improving the overall vendor experience.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.


Key job responsibilities
· Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
· Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
· In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
· Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
· Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
· Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
· Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
· Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
· Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
· Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
· Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
· Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
· Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

The Merchant In-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day-to-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long-term Merchant In-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and evangelize the long-term vision for Merchant In-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000+ stores by 2028

- Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro-markets, kiosks, grab-and-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self-service recovery mechanisms

- Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end-to-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets

- Own the JWO In-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day-to-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout-free environment

- Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade in-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements

- Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types

- Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean-time-to-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions

- Build and maintain relationships with enterprise customers and cross-functional stakeholders, gathering requirements from merchants operating at scale, understanding in-store operational constraints, and ensuring Merchant In-Store Operations capabilities meet current needs while anticipating future requirements as the business scales globally

description:
Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems at massive scale? As a Sr. Product Manager - Identity at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that directly shape our abuse prevention and CX strategy by building robust customer identity solutions. You will work backward from customer needs, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to tackle ambiguous problems, make high-judgment decisions, and drive products from concept through launch and beyond — all while operating in an environment that rewards creative thinking and a bias toward experimentation.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, using a combination of customer research, market analysis, and data-driven insights to prioritize investments and make smart trade-offs.
- Partner with engineering, design, science, and cross-functional teams to translate product strategy into well-scoped deliverables, define acceptance criteria, and drive execution from prototype through launch and post-launch optimization.
- Influence without authority across teams with different priorities, building alignment among stakeholders in engineering, marketing, sales, legal, finance, and operations to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
- Own product performance by defining success criteria and key metrics, analyzing usage data and customer behavior, and iterating rapidly to improve adoption, satisfaction, and business impact.
- Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, generate deeper insights, and identify new opportunities for product innovation.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and design partners, debating trade-offs on a new feature. After lunch, you lead a cross-functional alignment meeting to resolve dependencies with a partner team. Later, you draft a product narrative for an upcoming initiative, grounding your recommendations in customer research and data. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers (including our consumers, businesses, and drivers) across every interaction.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Service Delivery organization’s single threaded leader for CS Security. This role is responsible for owning the relationships with CS Security teams and the charter to empower associates whilst safeguarding customer data. You closely partner with CS Security in identifying and mitigating information security risks across all Customer Service systems, data, people, assets, and capabilities. The role consults and executes CS Security's strategy from the evolution of customer and agent authentication, creation and enforcement of security policy, to development of multi-layer security from servers to devices.

- An ideal candidate will combine product management depth in customer service operations or security with a demonstrated ability to implement AI-driven automation and modern project management tooling across distributed teams.
- You will partner with CS Security and Tech teams to define and design the end-to-end experience of associate and frontline leaders when security guardrails are applied. You will evaluate and improve existing tooling and processes and support the creation of new tech and AI driven solutions, consistently enhancing associate experiences and empowering our teams. You will work backward from security risks and associate pain points to design solutions and processes and define product requirements. Partnering with CS Security, engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams you will deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short-term tactical improvements with long-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience and empowerment.
- The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and/or security and deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering products that meet their customers’ needs. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.

This role can be located in Hyderabad.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end CS Security partnership for Service Delivery
- Own the security-related strategy and associate empowerment charter for Service Delivery
- Lead strategic planning processes, working with leaders across the organization to set goals, define priorities, and allocate resources.
- Write product requirements (PRFAQs, vision docs, BRDs, user stories) working backward from customer needs for both new launches and existing experience improvements.
- Collaborate with CS Security and Tech to influence strategy, drive prioritization, create operational plans, roadmaps and vision docs
- Define and own success metrics and KPIs; use data to measure success and ongoing portfolio health, informing roadmap prioritization
- Define and own framework and mechanisms as Service Delivery's single CS Security POC
- Translate associate and frontline leadership insights, data signals, and business requirements into actionable security process and product improvements and scalable solutions.
- Partner with CS Security, Tech, data science, and operations teams to deliver CS Security solutions features from concept through launch and iteration.
- Influence and align senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on direction and strategy through compelling narratives and data-driven recommendations
- Apply analytical rigor to frame trade-offs and enable leaders to make well-informed decisions.

The role is critical to ensure that Amazon’s payments businesses expand with appropriate controls and quality processes in place, minimizing risks and identifying opportunities for process improvement.

The quality control specialist will be an independent individual contributor, with effective problem-solving skills.

• Create and update guidance and program documents.
• Conduct a variety of investigation and audit types including suspicious activity, sanctions, and enhanced due diligence.
• Share industry expertise through audits and provide written, professional feedback.
• Apply an analytical and detailed thought process to various product types and services within an AML construct.
• Assist with linking policies, standard operating procedures, internal controls, monitoring, and reporting with the goal of improving operations, compliance policies, and risk management

description:
Role Overview
As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.

Strategic Ownership
Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making.
Technical Domain
Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:

Real-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
AI/ML-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1,400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels.
Multi-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML).
Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.
People Leadership
Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.
Customer & Operational Excellence
Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations.
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders.
Deliver Results
Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption.
Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership.
Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences — from engineering peers to senior leadership.


A day in the life
Strategic Vision & Roadmap
Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain — whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning
Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables
Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower
Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders
Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence
Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily
Manage software operations effectively — ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands
Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e.g., stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends)
Drive continuous improvement — improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership
People Management & Development
Independently manage a team of SDEs — hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals
Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs — build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization
Delegate appropriately — assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability
Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management
Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders — internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs
Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline — from Purchase Request through Handoff
Risk Management & Escalation
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks
Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders — especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments
Culture & Process
Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery
Use mechanisms, not good intentions — establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health
Drive root cause analysis — instill a culture of asking "5 whys," fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a new organization within AWS building large scale distributed applications. We will be designing and developing these systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.

If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and system design and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. To succeed in this role, you must be passionate about delivering high-quality designs and components. You must be creative in solving hard problems and unafraid to think out-of-the-box.

1. Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.

description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:

Be great fun to work with.
At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions

- Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions

- Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions

- Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.

- Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers

- Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development

- Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally


A day in the life
- Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
- Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
- Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
- Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
- Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

description:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Our operations team ensures that millions of customers across the globe receive visually compelling, culturally appropriate, and linguistically accurate content experiences by reviewing and refining artwork for publishing on Prime Video.
In this role, you will be the senior creative practitioner and quality benchmark for artwork — independently producing and correcting assets to Prime Video's creative and quality bar, and setting the working standard the broader operations team calibrates to. Operating with full ownership and without routine supervision, you will make the craft call on every asset you touch, refine non-compliant artwork until it is visually compelling and drives customer engagement, and translate your hands-on judgment into structured signals that improve our tools over time. This is a role for an accomplished creative professional who combines a strong design background with independent judgment and the credibility to define what “good” looks like for a global audience.


Key job responsibilities
• Validate and/or correct artwork in collaboration with studios (Cover, Background, and Poster variants) to Prime Video's creative and quality standards — making images visually compelling, aesthetically strong, and effective at driving customer engagement, without routine escalation.
• Set the working quality standard the broader team calibrates to — serving as the hands-on benchmark for what a correct, compelling asset looks like.
• Review metadata and content references to understand the creative intent of each title before finishing its artwork.
• Own the craft decision on every asset you touch, exercising independent judgment on compliance, visual appeal, and compellingness.
• Translate operational and editorial judgment into structured, actionable feedback that improves tool accuracy and output quality over time — capturing craft as reusable signal rather than one-off edits.
• Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for our production tools, synthesizing production experience into clear guidance for science and engineering teams.
• Champion a human-centered approach to AI — using AI as a tool that augments human creativity, never replaces it, and help define the quality and ethical guardrails for how it is used in production.
• Proactively identify process gaps and quality issues, propose solutions, and mentor team members on creative best practices as the team scales.


About the team
We are a brand new operations team within Prime Video, dedicated to ensuring that every piece of artwork displayed on the platform is compliant with our guidelines and standards, visually appealing, and compelling enough to drive customers to engage with Prime Video content. Based in Bangalore, India, the team operates at the intersection of technology and creative quality — reviewing and refining artwork across multiple languages and territories. As an early member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to shape processes from the ground up, influence the development of our production tools, and directly impact how millions of global customers discover and engage with Prime Video's content catalog.

description:
The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large-scale problems through creative solutions.

The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground-up re-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.

What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,
and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of
end-to-end systems exposure.

You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. You will shape foundational decisions in an active re-architecture program with high visibility to senior leadership

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and own end-to-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product managers, principal engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and working software.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying gaps in existing systems, proposing solutions, and delivering results with a high bar for quality and operational excellence.
Participate actively in code reviews, contribute to team best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the technical bar across the team.
Operate with a good sense of ownership — monitoring systems you build, responding to operational issues, and iterating quickly to improve customer and partner experience.

Operating with full ownership and without routine supervision, you will make the craft call on every asset you touch, refine non-compliant artwork until it is visually compelling and drives customer engagement, and translate your hands-on judgment into structured signals that improve our tools over time. This is a role for an accomplished creative professional who combines a strong design background with independent judgment and the credibility to define what “good” looks like for a global audience.


Key job responsibilities

• Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for our production tools, synthesizing production experience into clear guidance for science and engineering teams.
• Champion a human-centered approach to AI — using AI as a tool that augments human creativity, never replaces it, and help define the quality and ethical guardrails for how it is used in production.

About the team
We are a brand new operations team within Prime Video, dedicated to ensuring that every piece of artwork displayed on the platform is compliant with our guidelines and standards, visually appealing, and compelling enough to drive customers to engage with Prime Video content. Based in Bangalore, India, the team operates at the intersection of technology and creative quality — reviewing and refining artwork across multiple languages and territories. As an early member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to shape processes from the ground up, influence the development of our production tools, and directly impact how millions of global customers discover and engage with Prime Video's content catalog.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.


Key job responsibilities
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
- Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
- Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
- Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
- Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
- Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
- Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
- Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
- Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
- Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
- Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
- Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines
🔷 Handover & Documentation
- Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
- Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
- Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase
🔷 Rack Decommissioning
- Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
- Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
- Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
- Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
- Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool
🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
- Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
- Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
- Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity
🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
- Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
- Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
- Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately
🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
- Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
- Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
- Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
- Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
- Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!

Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.

As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world-class systems & software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day-to-day people and performance management tasks.

You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.

You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.

If you want to test your limits, build a world-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique products providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics and Apparel to Consumables and beyond. Fulfillment By Amazon enables Sellers to provide fast and efficient delivery to their customers using Amazon fulfillment services which stores, packs, ships and provides customer service for seller products. Sellers now make up the majority of the business on Amazon.com. The FBA team is responsible for the science, business, and operations of the core systems, algorithms, and seller-facing tools and workflows of the FBA service. These enable FBA sellers to enroll selection, plan and inbound product, and manage and action inventory in Amazon fulfillment network - managing through the full inventory lifecycle. FBA Capacity Management and Planning organization builds and manages tools worldwide for FBA capacity allocation, market-driven additional limit system, capacity management in emerging countries, inventory planning and forecasting, and the north-star seller-facing metric, the Inventory Performance Index.Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are scalable for automating large-scale business, inventory planning and optimization. We work with some of the best research scientists and software developers in the industry.

Key job responsibilities
You will leverage Native-AI SDLC to build software solutions for Amazon's WW selling partners. You design at the product level with heavy involvement through all phases of the SDLC using concepts that may include Service Oriented Architecture, caching, load balancing, non-relational databases, microservices, sharding, n-tiered architecture, cloud and/or map-reduce.
You use object-oriented design concepts to program large multi-tier systems. You have working knowledge of common and useful design patterns.
You have designed, refactored, re-architected, deprecated and/or implemented large-scale cloud-based distributed services with millisecond latency and ultra-high transactional volumes.
You have experience implementing best practices in improving team coding culture subjected related to quality and/or security
Effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to non-technical audiences.

In this job, you will…
Build Native-AI software solutions.
Experiment with whatever technology we need to get the job done.
Use Lean Software Development concepts such as Agile, Scrum and Kanban.
Use Test-Driven Development and Continuous Deployment.
Work with Senior and Principal Engineers, Researchers, and Data Engineers across multiple teams to design a new platform for optimizing supply chain management
Expand and optimize our world-class supply chain systems to support a variety of emerging business initiatives.
Automate third party supply management systems and break new ground to drive inventory across Amazon marketplaces.

description:
Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.

The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people-leadership and program-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.

This role operates in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.


Key job responsibilities
1. Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.
2. Build a high-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high-stakes problems independently.
3. Establish team-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.
4. Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross-cutting programs.
5. Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.
6. Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.
7. Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.
8. Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.
9. Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
10. Build and maintain deep team-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.


About the team
The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
