We are looking for a Category Manager to own and grow the Produce (F&V) & Perishable business at Amazon. This role sits at the intersection of category strategy, vendor management, and operational excellence — you will drive selection and pricing decisions, and ensure customers get the best availability and speed at sustainable economics.
This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast with data, and builds lasting relationships with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.
Core Responsibilities
1. Category Ownership & P&L Management
• Develop selection and pricing strategies grounded in market data, customer demand signals, and competitive benchmarking.
• Track category health metrics daily and drive corrective actions with speed.
2. Vendor Management & Sourcing Strategy
• Lead vendor relationships for Produce — negotiate terms, drive compliance, and build long-term partnerships.
• Build and execute a direct farmer / FPO sourcing roadmap to improve freshness, cost, and supply reliability.
• Identify and onboard high-potential vendors and emerging D2C produce brands.
3. Operational Excellence & Supply Planning
• Drive in-stock availability and speed-of-delivery targets for the category.
• Own seasonal demand and supply planning — anticipate volatility and build buffers proactively.
• Reduce Cost of Business Waste (CoBW) through process improvements across procurement, forecasting, and fulfillment.
• Partner with in-stock, logistics, and supply chain teams to resolve systemic gaps.
4. Market Insights & Strategy
• Continuously monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to surface opportunities.
• Generate data-driven recommendations for selection expansion, pricing adjustments, and new programs.
• Build long-range category forecasts in collaboration with partner teams.
5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with business leaders, city/regional vendor managers, in-stock managers, and marketing teams to align priorities.
• Lead structured discussions and ensure decisions are backed by quality inputs.
• Present category reviews and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
Basic Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience in category management, vendor management, or business development.
• Strong analytical skills — comfortable owning large datasets and drawing metric-based conclusions.
• Proficiency in Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookups) and SQL.
• Proven track record of managing vendor relationships and driving P&L outcomes.
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications
• MBA or Master's in Business, Supply Chain, or Agri-business.
• Prior experience in fresh produce, grocery, or perishables categories.
• Experience with demand forecasting, supply planning, or in-stock management.
• Familiarity with FPO / direct farmer sourcing models.
• Experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders.


Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end P&L for the Produce (F&V) category, including planning, forecasting, and driving growth — with a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business.
Develop and execute selection and pricing strategies grounded in market data, customer demand signals, and competitive benchmarking; continuously track market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
Lead vendor relationships for Produce — negotiate terms, drive compliance, and build long-term strategic partnerships; develop and execute a direct farmer / FPO sourcing roadmap to improve freshness, cost, and supply reliability.
Drive in-stock availability and speed-of-delivery targets; own seasonal demand and supply planning, anticipating volatility and building buffers proactively.
Reduce Cost of Business Waste (CoBW) through process improvements across procurement, forecasting, and fulfillment in partnership with in-stock, logistics, and supply chain teams.
Generate and implement ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the category, including building long-range forecasts in collaboration with partner teams.
Work closely with regional and city vendor managers, in-stock managers, and cross-functional teams to align priorities and ensure execution excellence.
Present category reviews, business performance, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
Identify and onboard high-potential vendors and emerging sourcing partners to strengthen and diversify the supply base.

description:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Specialist. In this key role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of security operations, delivering concrete on-the-ground contributions through direct operational support to our sites. You will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute day-to-day security operations and conduct regular physical security checks at assigned sites
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards


A day in the life
As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. Your daily focus will be on hands-on execution of security operations, including conducting physical security rounds, monitoring CCTV systems, and responding to immediate security concerns. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. You execute established procedures to address security incidents and implement approved solutions for identified vulnerabilities. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the Worldwide Operations Security organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:
• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation
Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

description:
We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our analytics team. This person will own the design and implementation of scalable and reliable approaches to support or automate decision making throughout the business.

You will do this by analyzing data with a variety of statistical techniques and then building, validating, and implementing models based your analysis. You will not be able to do this alone but by building partnerships across data, engineering, and business teams.

Key job responsibilities
Apply a range of data science techniques and tools combined with subject matter expertise to solve difficult customer or business problems and cases in which the solution approach is unclear.
Proactively seek to identify business opportunities and insights and provide solutions to automate and optimize key internal and external products based on a broad and deep knowledge of Amazon data, industry best-practices, and work done by other teams.
Dive deep into the data and other models across the business to identify defects or inefficiencies which materially impact the customer or business, but can be mitigated through corrective actions for the AB Ops use case
Acquire this data by accessing data sources and building the necessary SQL/ETL queries or scripts.
Analyze data for trends and input validity by inspecting univariate distributions, exploring bivariate relationships, constructing appropriate transformations, and tracking down the source and meaning of anomalies.
Build models and automated tools using statistical modeling, mathematical modeling, econometric modeling, network modeling, social network modeling, natural language processing, machine learning algorithms, genetic algorithms, and neural networks.
Validate these models against alternative approaches, expected and observed outcome, and other business defined key performance indicators.
Implement these models in a manner which complies with evaluations of the computational demands, accuracy, and reliability of the relevant ETL processes at various stages of production.
Enable product engineering teams to consume your models through services which can directly power customer-facing experiences.
Inspect the key business metrics/KPIs (even if you did not create them) when your analytics work points to potential gaps or opportunities; providing clear, compelling analyses by leveraging your knowledge across the AWS suite of products to support the broader business.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the core Amazon delivery capabilities for commercial addresses. While Amazon has built its core operations over the last two decades mostly catered towards the end-consumer, we recognize that the business customers have unique needs and require a different set of features and services from their e-Commerce provider.

description:
The Regional WHS Manager will lead Amazon FC WHS operations across multiple INFC sites in the South region in India. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about safety and will help build a world class WHS organization and a strong WHS culture. The leader will be responsible for leading a team of safety mangers and partnering with operations teams in Fulfillment Centers to execute the company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The WHS leader will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies. He will be required to possess excellent safety program and relevant environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrate this expertise when working with Operations. The Regional WHS Manager will be responsible to lead a team of safety managers and safety teams at different INFC site locations in their assigned region. This individual must help execute leadership development plans for their Safety team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to the safety managers/ teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon safety professional.




Key job responsibilities
• Measure and communicate the site's performance against published requirements in safety policies.
• Ensure site leadership is trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
• Ensure site leadership is provided with current and regular safety information that enables them to discuss safety with their peers, associates, and contracted workforce.
• Spend time on the floor, yard, and dock seeking input from associates, contracted workforce, and leaders on safety improvement opportunities.
Possess a thorough understanding of local and regional regulations and company policy, including Motor Vehicle and Transport Safety regulations applicable to transportation and operations.
• Inform leadership when they are required to resolve a safety concern or suggestion.
• Lead proactive hazard identification (including road safety, vehicle safety, loading/unloading operations, and yard management), communicate results, and track open items to resolution.
• Ensure a timely, thorough, and accurate response to uncontrolled risks once they are discovered.
• Plan and carry out peer audits to ensure compliance with the organization's safety policies.
• Analyse incident data (including road incidents, vehicle telematics data, and on-site incidents) to identify trends and justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
• Escalate risks that present an imminent danger to life or health, or where the solution is either insufficient to protect associates and contracted workforce from harm or is delayed in being fully implemented.

description:
The Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is Amazon’s 24/7 centralized command center supporting Worldwide Amazon Stores. The GSOC manages critical incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and brand reputation by connecting sites with the appropriate subject matter experts and coordinating end-to-end incident response. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

The Security Operations Manager, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) will provides critical support and timely notification to global partners regarding incidents that have impacted, or have the potential to impact, Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand. They will assist in managerial ownership of their shift and be responsible for ensuring performance SLAs are met, that responses are appropriate according to policies and procedures, and for developing and motivating a highly performant staff. The Security Operations Manager must also deal effectively with ambiguity and make response-related decisions sometimes with incomplete information in the best interest of Amazon.
The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate elevated judgment while operating under pressure. They must possess the ability to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles to identify barriers and initiate actions to resolve. The candidate should possess a proven record of working across multiple organizations to resolve escalations where the problem and solutions, as well as risk strategy, may not be well defined.
The GSOC is a 24/7/365 operation, and this position will require shift work, including night and weekend shifts.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead 24/7 GSOC shift operations, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and Amazon’s brand.
• Provide timely notifications, situation reports, and executive briefings to global stakeholders
• Ensure shift operational excellence by maintaining ownership of performance, achieving established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and driving consistent execution of policies and procedures
• Partner with Security, Operations, HR, Workplace Health & Safety (WHS), Legal, Communications and other internal stakeholders to coordinate effective incident response and business continuity support.
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Operations Security Specialists by setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and feedback, and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
• Monitor incident trends, operational metrics, and emerging risks to identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen response capabilities, and reduce recurring issues.
• Lead post-incident reviews and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience, standardize best practices, and enhance the effectiveness of global incident management.
• Partner with cross-functional and global teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve processes, tools, and operational standards that support scalable, efficient GSOC operations.
• Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, and customer obsession while protecting Amazon’s associates, operations, and brand.


A day in the life
As a GSOC Security Operations Manager, you will lead a team responsible for managing critical security and operational incidents across Amazon’s global network. Your day may include directing responses to workplace emergencies, severe weather events, security threats, transportation incidents, or operational disruptions while coordinating with multiple business partners and executive stakeholders. You will coach your team in real time, provide strategic guidance during escalations, ensure operational metrics are met, and continuously improve processes that strengthen Amazon’s global incident management capability.

description:
The Amazon Delivery and Shopping Experience Product Team is looking for a talented Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer who develop solutions to optimize customer experience by disproportionately improving discoverability and speed. As part of Amazon’s DEX product team, we have the opportunity to be at the forefront of DEX product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs. We need strong BIEs who enjoy and excel at diving into data, analyzing root causes, defining long-term solutions and driving their implementation with stakeholders.

This position requires superior analytical thinkers, able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply your technical and engineering expertise to rapidly prototype and deliver solutions. This skill also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including software tech teams, operations, finance, category, search, and inventory platform (software) teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, extract and manipulate data across various data marts, and align research focuses on Amazon’s strategic needs.

We are NOT a reporting team and we are not looking for reporting analysts. We are looking for people with a flair for recognizing trends and patterns while correlating it to the business problem at hand. If you have an uncanny ability to decipher the exact policy/mechanism/solution to address the challenge and ability to influence people using hard data (and some tact) then we are looking for you!

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. BIE in the team, you will work closely with program managers, software developers, research scientists, and product managers to analyze massive data sets, identify areas to improve, define metrics to measure and monitor programs, and most importantly work with different stakeholders to drive improvements over time. You will also work closely with internal business teams to extract or mine information from our existing systems to create new analysis, and expose data from our group to wider teams in intuitive ways. As a BIE embedded in the product team you have the opportunity to participate and shape product development as well as leverage your technical skills. This position provides opportunities to influence high visibility/high impact areas in the organization.

A day in the life
- You will perform complex data analysis (root cause deep dives, correlations, regressions, simulations, optimization) to identify different opportunities to improve sales, improve Prime shipping and delivery benefits, reduce ship costs, improve discoverability, etc.
- You will own end-to-end program management. You will not only develop insights but devise realistic plans and work with key stakeholders (software managers, product managers, retail business managers, sellers, transportation planners/managers, and warehouse managers ) to execute them.
- You will be responsible for adding YY million $ to top line or reducing XX million $ actual savings on the bottom line. You will not be responsible for only "recommendation" but actual improvements made to bottom or top line.
- You will engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy and outlook.
- You will be a subject matter expert in best in class customer experience policies at Amazon. You will understand intricate details of our promise and ordering systems along with their impact on ground-level operations

About the team
As Amazon International Emerging Stores’ DEX product team, we are at the forefront of the Customer Experience product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and translating these concepts into robust scalable products that deliver tangible value to our customers and to the A.in business.

description:
Alexa International is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist to help build industry-leading technology with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech models, requiring strong deep learning and generative models knowledge. You will contribute to developing novel solutions and deliver high-quality results that impact Alexa's international products and services.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist with the Alexa International team, you will work with talented peers to develop novel algorithms and modeling techniques to advance the state of the art with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech model. Your work will directly impact our international customers in the form of products and services that make use of digital assistant technology. You will leverage Amazon's heterogeneous data sources, unique and diverse international customer nuances and large-scale computing resources to accelerate advances in text, voice, and vision domains in a multimodal setup. The ideal candidate possesses a solid understanding of machine learning, natural language understanding, modern LLM architectures, LLM evaluation & tooling, and a passion for pushing boundaries in this vast and quickly evolving field. They thrive in fast-paced environments to tackle complex challenges, excel at swiftly delivering impactful solutions while iterating based on user feedback, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

A day in the life
* Analyze, understand, and model customer behavior and the customer experience based on large-scale data.
* Build novel online & offline evaluation metrics and methodologies for multimodal personal digital assistants.
* Drive research in ASR, TTS, and Speech-to-Speech (S2S) model training and fine-tuning
* Advance multilingual speech recognition and synthesis using LLM-based architectures
* Fine-tune/post-train LLMs using techniques like SFT, DPO, RLHF, and RLAIF.
* Collaborate with partner teams on evaluation frameworks and post-training methodologies.
* Communicate solutions clearly to partners and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications and community engagement.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

description:
Amazon’s eCommerce Foundation (eCF) organization is responsible for the core components that drive the Amazon website and customer experience. Serving millions of customer page views and orders per day, eCF builds for scale. As an organization within eCF, the Business Data Technologies (BDT) group is no exception. We also support Amazon subsidiaries such as IMDB and Audible. We provide interfaces for our internal customers to access and query the data hundreds of thousands of times per day, using Amazon Web Service’s (AWS) Redshift, EMR, Glue, LakeFormation and SageMaker. We build scalable solutions that grow with Amazon’s business.

BDT is growing, and the data processing landscape is shifting. Our data is consumed by thousands of teams across Amazon including Research Scientists, Machine Learning Specialists, Business Analysts and Data Engineers.

We are developing innovative products including the next-generation of data catalog, data discovery engine, data transformation, machine learning, and more with AWS technologies.

We're looking for talented engineers to build them from the ground up.

This is a hands-on position where you will design and build extremely scalable components and features for data processing at Amazon. You will work closely with senior engineers to solve challenging technical problems and collaborate with internal customers to help them get the best results. You should be a strong software developer with solid programming skills, an understanding of data structures and algorithms, and a passion for massive-scale computing. A desire to learn, deliver results, and grow as an engineer is essential.

* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
* Write clean, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across the software stack.

The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

description:
If you’re excited about solving deep technical challenges and building innovative software that directly influences how Amazon Now Dark Stores and fulfillment centers are designed and launched from the ground up, this could be a the role for you. You’ll join a team being built from scratch in Bengaluru—offering a rare opportunity to be an early member and help shape how we operate, innovate, and scale.

The Team
Within Amazon Robotics’ Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) organization, the Customer Experience Infrastructure (CXI) team delivers region-specific, customer-centric solutions focused on cost optimization, operational transparency, process simplification, and lifecycle management. Our mission is to reduce the cost and time required to build and operate the Tech infra in Amazon fulfillment centers, Whole Foods stores, and quick commerce stores.

The Role
Everyone on our team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment that’s more startup than big company. We’re solving problems that will help you develop expertise across multiple domains including: Amazon dark store and fulfillment center supply chain systems, Warehouse management solution, Network infra, End-user equipment, Machine Learning, and Distributed Systems. Your primary focus will be designing and building software services that dramatically reduce the cost and time required to launch Amazon fulfillment centers, Whole Foods and quick commerce stores.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE, you are responsible for setting a high bar throughout the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, and operations.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development(both backend and frontend) in Java, Python, react, AWS technologies. He/she will work closely with the business and technical teams to analyze many non-standard and unique business problems and use creative problem solving to build quick Proofs of concept and deliver production grade software.
He/she will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big and be creative while paying careful attention to detail and will enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.


A day in the life
Our team follows the Agile development methodology. Team members(SDEs/PMT/TPM) participate in daily stand-ups and bi-weekly sprint planning and backlog grooming sessions. You will write code for both user-facing APIs and backend services that need to be fault-tolerant and low-latency. You will participate in design reviews, contribute to technical discussions, and collaborate with other teams within Customer Experience Infra Org on integration solutions. We conduct annual program planning and quarterly prioritization meetings to align tasks with organizational goals. Developers, Program Management (PM) team, and Single-Threaded Owners (STOs) collaborate to define and execute these tasks. Since it’s a new team, we do not have any operational load at present, but in future we will operational maintain what we deliver this year.

description:
Alexa International is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist to help build industry-leading technology with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech models, requiring strong deep learning and generative models knowledge. You will contribute to developing novel solutions and deliver high-quality results that impact Alexa's international products and services.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist with the Alexa International team, you will work with talented peers to develop novel algorithms and modeling techniques to advance the state of the art with Large Language Models (LLMs), ASR, TTS, and Speech to Speech model. Your work will directly impact our international customers in the form of products and services that make use of digital assistant technology. You will leverage Amazon's heterogeneous data sources, unique and diverse international customer nuances and large-scale computing resources to accelerate advances in text, voice, and vision domains in a multimodal setup. The ideal candidate possesses a solid understanding of machine learning, natural language understanding, modern LLM architectures, LLM evaluation & tooling, and a passion for pushing boundaries in this vast and quickly evolving field. * Drive research in ASR, TTS, and Speech-to-Speech (S2S) model training and fine-tuning
* Advance multilingual speech recognition and synthesis using LLM-based architectures
* Fine-tune/post-train LLMs using techniques like SFT, DPO, RLHF, and RLAIF.
* Collaborate with partner teams on evaluation frameworks and post-training methodologies.
* Communicate solutions clearly to partners and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications and community engagement.

description:

Our work directly protects hundreds of millions of dollars in advertiser spend annually while maintaining a seamless user experience.

- Directly protect hundreds of millions of dollars in advertiser spend annually while maintaining seamless user experience.

description:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $60 billion global business serving over 11 million organizations worldwide. At Amazon Business, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech and retail in the B2B space, developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations reimagine buying. Bring your insight, imagination, and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes, unlocking our potential worldwide.
This role is part of the Amazon Business India. Our mission is to scale Amazon Business as the trusted procurement partner for Mid & Large Enterprise customers, by enabling them to leverage data-driven insights and enhancing sales programs & processes. We are looking for a Sales Operations Leader who will own the end-to-end operational backbone supporting our India Enterprise sales teams.
You will be responsible for strategic planning, funnel management, sales automation, customer data governance, reporting, and Salesforce administration — ensuring our sales teams are equipped with the right data, tools, and processes to deliver exceptional customer outcomes at scale. You will drive improvements in planning accuracy, system capabilities, sales productivity, and enable effective execution — ultimately contributing to sustainable business growth through operational excellence.


Key job responsibilities
1. Strategic Planning: Design customer segmentation across SMB-Mid-Large-Strat cohorts, set quotas for sales teams, plan territories balancing capacity and potential, drive annual business planning with Finance and Category teams, lead the Kingpin goals for Sales & Operational excellence.
2. Funnel Management: Own Spend pipeline hygiene, enforce stage progression standards, drive forecast accuracy through deal inspection cadences, partner with cross-orgs or cross-geos for complex account partnerships, and support AEs on SFDC opportunity management.
3. Sales Automation: Leverage analytics team bandwidth to launch and drive adoption of Go-To-Market-Operations AI tools, track Productivity Hours Saved metrics, and prototype lightweight AI workflows for India-specific use cases.
4. Customer Data: Own CPS customer data, SFDC lifecycle stage hygiene, industry penetration, manage channel assignment logic, and enforce data governance standards across SFDC.
5. Reporting: Partner with BI to produce quality WBRs, AE performance dashboards, quota tracking with variance analysis, and ad-hoc deep dive requests.
6. Centre of Excellence: Act as the trusted, strategic advisor for AB country leader on matters of Sales pipeline hygiene, effectiveness and efficiency

A day in the life
No two days look the same. In a given week, you might kick off Monday by reviewing WBR data and briefing AB Country Leadership on pipeline variances. By mid-morning, you are deep in a territory rebalancing exercise to scale new CPS customer segment with the BI team. After lunch, you lead a training session on the latest GTMO AI tool release, walking AEs through use cases that save 2+ hours per week. On Wednesday, you partner with the WW SFDC team to deploy a new workflow automation that eliminates a manual deal-stage update. Thursday brings a deep dive to align new SFDC lifecycle stage process. By Friday, you have shipped a refreshed Account Executive performance dashboard, and drafted a proposal for expanding AVA coverage to a new customer segment — all while keeping the operational engine running seamlessly in the background.

About the team
The India Sales Operations team is a high-impact group embedded at the intersection of sales strategy and execution. You will report to the India Amazon Business Director and collaborate daily with CPS Sales & Product professionals, as well as cross-functional partners in Category, Technology, BI, Finance, and WW Sales Ops counterparts in the US, JP, EU.
You will partner directly with Sales leadership to build and scale the programs, tools, and processes that drive customer performance. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and believe that the best operational work is invisible to the people it serves — because it simply works.

description:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.

Key job responsibilities
System Architecture & Design
- Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second
- Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption
- Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

description:
Amazon’s Marketplace business is one of the largest in the world operating in 23 countries. Amazon Marketplace enables millions of Sellers worldwide to list hundreds of millions of products and manage orders for inventory across dozens of different categories and languages.

The IN Seller Partner Services Tech organization is responsible for building delightful seller experiences with the vision of being the technology foundation that makes Amazon the #1 choice for sellers of all types and price-sensitive customers in India and emerging markets—transforming how a billion people buy and sell, thereby transforming lives. By making its sellers successful, Amazon can attract and retain sellers on the platform, which in turn offers its customers the best selection, convenience, pricing and experience resulting in multi-billion-dollar business. This organization enables sellers of all stripes across a multitude of business lines existing or new such as Q-Commerce, Pharmacy and Out of country selling.

We are looking for a motivated and innovative Applied Scientist with strong analytical skills and practical experience to join our science team. As a key member of our science team, you will provide expertise that helps accelerate the business and make it profitable. You will research, design and improve on the models that will directly impact Amazon’s Selection quality and maximize fee revenue. You will be working in a highly collaborative environment partnering with various science, product management, engineering, operations, finance, business intelligence and analytics teams. You will design tests to explain performance of the models from impact on customer and cost perspective. You will create ML models to capture features impacting performance. You should be comfortable building prototypes, testing and improving them given the feedback from the real time data. You should be able to present your model and findings to a various range of stakeholders.

Looking for candidate with expertise in the areas of machine learning, operations research, and statistics. With expertise in applying theoretical models in an applied environment relying heavily on the latest advances in machine learning, optimization, stochastic modeling, and engineering. The candidate will be expected to work on numerous aspects, such as feature engineering, modeling, probabilistic modeling, hyper-parameter tuning, scalable inference methods and latent variable models. Challenges will involve dealing with very large data sets and requirements on throughput.

- Create experiments and prototype implementations of new learning algorithms and prediction techniques

- Collaborate with scientists, engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to design and implement software solutions for science problems

- Use best practices to ensure a high standard of quality for all of the team deliverables

description:
Amazon is looking for a Category Manager to drive category growth and strategic partnerships for the Gift Cards business. This is a rare blend of Category Management and Business Development; a role that offers deeper control over critical growth levers and places you at the exciting intersection of online retail and fintech.

Gift Cards offer a unique value proposition by not just being a gifting product but also a payment instrument. With Gift Cards being significantly underpenetrated in the Gifting industry and Amazon Pay Gift Cards having a lion's share in the Gift Cards market, this role offers exponential growth potential and a unique opportunity to shape the industry.

If you thrive on ownership, this role offers early P&L responsibility, a rare accelerator for a successful long-term career. You will own revenue and profitability goals, set the long-term vision for your category, and drive insights-based product innovation.

Key job responsibilities
A.Category Management & Retail Inputs

1. Drive core retail inputs of selection, pricing, and customer experience to drive consistent improvements across key topline and CX metrics
2. Drive demand-generation by funneling Amazon's internal traffic through navigational & merchandised assets to Gift Cards

B.Business Development & Account Management

1. Identify, pitch and onboard new sellers, brands and vendors into the Gift Cards ecosystem; negotiate strategic agreements and build long-term partner relationships
2. Own end-to-end account management for 3P Branded Gift Cards (sellers/brands) and Amazon Pay Gift Cards (vendors), driving regular business reviews and joint planning with partners

C.Business Planning & Long-Term Ownership

1. Independently build quarterly and monthly plans to achieve annual goals; present business reviews to internal stakeholders
2. Own full P&L for your category, set the long-term vision, collaborate with Product & Tech on the roadmap, and unlock alternate revenue channels through insights-based innovation

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing topline metrics to spot trends needing immediate attention. By mid-morning, you're pitching a leading lifestyle brand with data-backed ideas to grow their Gift Cards issuance volume on Amazon. Post-lunch, you refine pricing strategies, review selection gaps and work with the catalog team to improve the CX on detail pages. You then sync with Product & Tech on a roadmap feature that could unlock a new revenue channel. Later, you're preparing a quarterly business review for leadership. Before wrapping up, you check in on a key 3P seller's concern regarding poor customer ratings.

description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.

Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
- Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
- Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
- Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
- Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
- Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
- Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
- Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements 
- Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. Key job responsibilities

- Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
- Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

description:
Category Manager – Pricing Strategy & Operations

We're seeking a Category Manager to anchor the Pricing Strategy and Pricing Operations charter for Core Consumables at Amazon. This role presents an extraordinary opportunity to architect the pricing architecture for high-velocity categories, drive margin and competitiveness outcomes at scale, and build the operating systems that keep pricing sharp every single day.

Core Responsibilities

1. Pricing Strategy & Architecture

Own the end-to-end pricing strategy for consumables and beauty verticals, balancing price competitiveness, margin improvement, and customer trust
Design tiered pricing frameworks across category roles (traffic drivers, basket builders, margin drivers) and define pricing posture by brand, selection type, and competitive intensity
Architect pricing constructs for new vertical launches — introductory pricing, promotional cadence, and steady-state price positioning
Develop ASP uplift and margin improvement roadmaps with clearly quantified bps-level goals
Define pricing guardrails and exception frameworks for high-visibility and price-sensitive ASINs

2. Pricing Operations & Execution

Build and run the weekly/daily pricing operations rhythm — price fixing cadences, competitive price matching, and anomaly detection and correction
Drive automation of pricing workflows in partnership with tech/product teams; reduce manual interventions and improve pricing SLA adherence
Establish price quality audit mechanisms — coverage, accuracy, and speed of competitive price responses
Manage promotional pricing execution, event pricing readiness, and post-event price normalization
Own PPU/unit-price integrity, MRP compliance, and pricing hygiene across the catalogue

3. Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights

Continuously track competitor pricing movements, promotional patterns, and market pricing trends
Build and maintain competitive price benchmarking frameworks and dashboards for leadership visibility
Translate elasticity insights and market data into actionable pricing recommendations

4. Strategic Leadership & Collaboration

Partner with category, instock, vendor management, and finance leaders to align pricing decisions with P&L goals
Lead collaborative decision-making on pricing trade-offs (growth vs. margin, competitiveness vs. profitability)
Present pricing strategy recommendations, performance reviews, and escalations to senior leadership
Negotiate funding and price support with brands/sellers to enable sharp pricing without margin dilution

5. Ensure High-Quality Pricing Inputs

Ensure best-in-class inputs — competitive crawls, cost structures, elasticity data — feed pricing decisions
Develop and maintain frameworks for gathering, validating, and incorporating pricing inputs from stakeholders and data systems

Qualifications

Master's degree in business, economics, or a related field
Proven experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, or category P&L ownership
Strong analytical skills — comfort with elasticity analysis, margin modeling, and large datasets (SQL/Excel proficiency preferred)
Demonstrated ability to build and run operational cadences with high execution rigor
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence without authority
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

Key job responsibilities
Setup the right frameworks for deciding the right Pricing Strategy
Work with multiple internal stakeholders to operationalize the Pricing strategy
Setup best in class practices to help consumers make the right choice

description:
Amazon Ads delivers advertising experiences across Amazon's owned-and-operated properties and third-party networks, reaching hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. Within Amazon Ads, Advertising Trust is the science-first organization responsible for ensuring every ad shown to customers meets Amazon's content policies — at massive scale, across all ad formats and global marketplaces.
The Ads Trust Science team builds the ML systems that automate content moderation decisions: multimodal classification, retrieval-based labeling, LLM reasoning, and agentic self-improvement architectures. This requires inventing new approaches at the intersection of computer vision, NLP, information retrieval, and generative AI.
We are seeking an Applied Science Manager to lead a team of applied scientists building next-generation content moderation intelligence. You will own the science roadmap for one of the highest-impact automation programs in Amazon Advertising, defining how multimodal content understanding, retrieval-first classification, and LLM-based reasoning combine into a production system that serves global advertising at scale.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead a team of applied scientists working across multimodal ML (vision-language models, video understanding), large-scale retrieval systems (embedding-based similarity and deduplication), and generative AI (LLM-based policy reasoning, knowledge distillation, agentic architectures, reinforcement learning).
* Define the science strategy for ads trust.
* Own end-to-end delivery of ML solutions: problem formulation, offline experimentation, online A/B testing, and production deployment. Your models directly move automation and defect metrics reported to senior leadership.
* Build and grow scientists — hire, mentor, and develop team members. Raise the science bar through structured review processes and a publication culture within Amazon.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to translate science investments into measurable automation improvements. Influence roadmaps across dependent teams.
* Communicate science strategy and results to senior leadership through narratives, technical deep-dives, and roadmap documents.

Along with primarily supporting on Concessions investigations, the SLP Specialist will be required to provide on-ground intel useful in uncovering abuse MOs. description:
READY TO UNLOCK FBA'S NEXT CHAPTER?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the service that lets sellers worldwide leverage Amazon's world-class logistics infrastructure — storage, fulfillment, delivery, returns — as a service. Sellers from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses in 135+ countries rely on FBA to grow and thrive. Today, FBA powers tens of billions in annual GMS across dozens of product categories.

But some of the largest, most valuable product categories remain structurally under-penetrated on FBA. Heavy and bulky goods, high-value electronics, multi-box furniture, and commercial B2B products represent hundreds of billions in addressable market — categories where customers and sellers want FBA but where seller economics, fulfillment architecture, and trust barriers have prevented adoption. These aren't emerging markets; they're established, proven segments where FBA's infrastructure hasn't yet caught up to demand.

We are building a team dedicated to solving these category-level structural barriers — redesigning fee architectures, building new fulfillment capabilities, closing cost-to-serve gaps against 3PLs, and earning seller trust at price points where every defect matters. This is a multi-year charter with leadership alignment, end-to-end ownership, and the mandate to work across organizational boundaries to deliver what no single team has been able to solve alone.

We operate with startup intensity inside Amazon — small teams, fast cycles, and the freedom to invent. Come build the systems that unlock FBA's biggest untapped opportunities.

- Design and build end-to-end systems that remove structural barriers to FBA adoption.
- Own the technical architecture for your domain, balancing speed-to-market with long-term scalability across FBA's global footprint
- Work across organizational boundaries — our charter includes alignment to make changes on partner teams' systems where needed to deliver the mission
- Translate complex business problems (cost-to-serve optimization, supply chain defect reduction, category-specific seller economics) into clean, scalable technical solutions
- Influence technical direction across the broader FBA platform by contributing design patterns, shared infrastructure, and experimentation frameworks that other teams adopt
- Mentor engineers on the team and shape engineering culture as we grow

description:
Amazon Studios is the original content arm of Amazon.com, responsible for producing content that engages our customers across the globe, including successful series/shows such as
"Family Man", "Raakh", and "Matka King".
We are seeking an experienced contract administrator/business affairs coordinator, who's role will be two fold: this individual will be involved in heavily administrative functions as well as work closely with Business Affairs Lead and Business Affairs execs to coordinate on business affairs matters with internal and external stakeholders across all shows/movies as well as on downstream talent deals.
A successful candidate will need to have a good working knowledge of the basics on deal making in the India entertainment industry; have dealt with paperwork/contracts at a basic level, have high level of organisational skills and be able to handle high volume tasks at a given time. Their prior experience of working for an
entertainment agency, studio or organization will be helpful; and provide turnaround quickly with little to no guidance; react with appropriate urgency to situations and events that require quick response or turnaround. The candidate will also have excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. A high level of competence integrity and discretion in handling confidential information and professionalism in dealing with senior professionals inside and outside the company is key.
This position is located in Mumbai.

Key job responsibilities
Contract Administration & Management
Processing contracts for original content productions, including talent agreements, production services agreements, licensing deals, and ancillary agreements
Managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle from initiation through execution, ensuring timely turnaround and compliance with internal policies
Coordinating contract amendments, extensions, and renewals in alignment with business requirements
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date contract records across internal systems and databases
Rights Management
Administering rights management tools and systems to track content rights, license windows, and territorial availability
Ensuring accurate entry and maintenance of deal and title information, including key dates, statuses, and rights parameters
Conducting periodic audits of rights data to identify and resolve discrepancies or data quality issues
Supporting rights clearance processes for content distribution across multiple territories
Stakeholder Coordination
Serving as a key liaison between Business Affairs, Creative, Production, Marketing, Accounting, Finance, and Legal teams
Coordinating with external partners including production houses, talent representatives, and vendors to facilitate contract execution
Managing communication workflows to ensure all parties are aligned on deal terms, timelines, and deliverables
Escalating issues and flagging risks to senior Business Affairs leadership in a timely manner
Deal Support & Documentation
Assisting Business Affairs Executives in structuring and closing deals by preparing deal summaries, comparison sheets, and financial breakdowns
Tracking deal milestones, payment schedules, and deliverable timelines to ensure contractual obligations are met
Preparing and maintaining deal trackers, status reports, and dashboards for leadership visibility
Supporting due diligence processes by gathering and organizing relevant documentation
Process Management & Compliance
Ensuring adherence to internal approval workflows, signature protocols, and compliance requirements
Raising and managing tickets for data corrections, system updates, and process exceptions
Identifying opportunities for process improvement and contributing to the development of standard operating procedures
Supporting cross-functional initiatives related to system implementations, tool migrations, and workflow optimization
Multi-Territory Support
Providing contract administration support across multiple territories and regions
Adapting to varying legal frameworks, business practices, and operational requirements across geographies
Stepping up to cover additional territorial responsibilities during transition periods or team changes
Reporting & Analytics
Generating regular reports on contract status, deal pipeline, and key performance metrics
Tracking turnaround times, SLA adherence, and workload distribution for business review meetings
Contributing data and insights for weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews

A day in the life
As a Business Affairs Coordinator, no two days are the same — but every day is fast-paced. You'll start your morning triaging contract requests and updating rights management systems, ensuring deal data is accurate and current across territories. By midday, you're coordinating with Creative, Legal, Finance, and Production teams to keep deals moving forward. Afternoons are spent processing contracts, preparing deal summaries for executives in active negotiations, and tracking milestones to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll wrap up the day updating trackers, flagging escalations, and handing off to international counterparts across time zones.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on organization, loves working at the intersection of content and commerce, and can juggle multiple priorities without missing a beat.

About the team
Who We Are
We are a close-knit team of 8 within Business Affairs at Amazon Studios, responsible for the contractual and rights management backbone that powers content across multiple territories. We sit at the intersection of creative ambition and business execution — ensuring that every deal, agreement, and rights window is structured, documented, and delivered with precision.
Our Mission
To enable the seamless acquisition, production, and distribution of world-class content by providing best-in-class business affairs support — moving at the speed of the business while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.
Our Culture
We believe great work doesn't have to come at the cost of a great work environment. Our team culture is built on three pillars:
Fun — We celebrate wins (big and small), share laughs over coffee, and genuinely enjoy each other's company. Whether it's a team lunch after closing a complex deal or friendly banter on a busy afternoon, we don't take ourselves too seriously.
Learning — We are endlessly curious. From cross-training on new territories to deep-diving into evolving industry practices, we invest in each other's growth. Questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared freely, and no one is expected to have all the answers on day one.
Work — When it's go-time, we deliver. We take pride in our craft — the precision of a well-structured deal, the satisfaction of a clean data set, the reliability of meeting every deadline. We hold ourselves and each other to a high bar, and we have each other's backs when the pressure is on.
What You Can Expect
Joining this team means joining a group that will challenge you, support you, and make you better at what you do — all while making sure you enjoy the ride. We move fast, we learn constantly, and we have fun doing it.

description:
We are seeking an experienced Sr. Program Manager to join the ROC WFM team in Hyderabad. This is a unique Individual Contributor (IC) role that combines two critical functions: Program Management at scale and Real-Time Monitoring (RTM) leadership.
The successful candidate will drive strategic programs across worldwide teams (NA, EU, IN) while simultaneously guiding the RTM team to ensure real-time operational excellence. This role demands a leader who can influence without authority, think backwards from the customer, champion ruthless automation, and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
You will work at the intersection of operations and technology, partnering with Tech, Operations, Finance, PXT, Product, and ACES teams to deliver outcomes that improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the associate and customer experience.


Key job responsibilities
Program Management
• Drive programs at scale across ROC WFM, defining program requirements, milestones, and success metrics
• Own and drive Weekly Business Reviews (WBR), Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
• Champion ruthless automation — identify manual processes and drive automated, scalable solutions to improve forecasting, demand planning, and operational efficiency
• Scope business and functional requirements for Amazon Tech teams to create and enhance WFM software systems and tools
• Define strategy and operationalize planning to ensure efficient delivery and customer satisfaction
• Apply AI backward thinking — leverage data science and machine learning opportunities to drive predictive and prescriptive WFM solutions
• Systematically escalate problems or variances in data to relevant owners and follow through on resolutions

Real-Time Monitoring & RTM Team Leadership
• Guide and mentor the RTM team, providing direction on real-time monitoring of staffing levels, service levels, and operational adherence across all ROC sites
• Establish and refine RTM processes, SOPs, and escalation frameworks to ensure 24/7 operational coverage
• Monitor real-time performance trends, identify anomalies, and drive immediate corrective actions
• Partner with ACES and Tech teams to identify trends impacting long-term and short-term resource planning
• Drive continuous improvement in RTM tools, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms
• Influence without authority — guide RTM associates and cross-functional partners toward operational excellence without direct reporting authority




About the team
About ROC (Relay Operations Center)
The Relay Operations Center (ROC) is Amazon's central command and control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon Supply Chain network. Supporting multiple geographies including North America (NA), Europe (EU), and India (IN), ROC ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers and from fulfillment centers to carrier hubs.
In case of any exceptions during the transportation lifecycle, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all stakeholders informed. Beyond tactical problem-solving, ROC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve its customers on time.

About ROC WFM (Workforce Management)
The Workforce Management (WFM) team within ROC is responsible for ensuring the right people are in the right place at the right time to support 24/7 transportation operations. The WFM function encompasses:
• Volume forecasting and demand planning across all ROC operational sites
• Long-term and short-term capacity planning and resource allocation
• Real-Time Monitoring (RTM) of staffing levels, adherence, and service levels
• Scheduling optimization and shift management across geographies
• Driving automation and AI-powered solutions to enhance planning accuracy and operational efficiency
The WFM team partners closely with Operations, Tech, ACES, Finance, PXT, and Product teams to deliver scalable workforce solutions that support ROC's mission of flawless transportation execution.

description:
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
• Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
• Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
• Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
• Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
• Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
• Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
• Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
• Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
• Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
• Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
• Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.

About the team
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.
