description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a world class engineering team to lead the Electrical design of our Data Centers across our rapidly expanding Asia Pacific (APAC) portfolio.

We're looking for candidates that share our customer obsession by providing innovative solutions to enhance our market leading reliability. Technical leaders that can explain complex systems in clear and concise language. We contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale. We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience across the project lifecycle from concept design through construction, to commissioning and handover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, consultants and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence and a 25% travel will be expected as part of this role. Projects will be throughout the region and a degree of international travel and support will be necessary.

We are the leaders in our industry. We always strive to improve in every aspect of our business. Continuous improvement through Lean Engineering practices is fundamental to our business. As an engineer within our team you will spend a regular part of your time analyzing and improving every aspect of our value stream.

Key job responsibilities
The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the following:
• Lead Data center electrical designs in collaboration with other disciplines to create a coordinated construction document set
• Participate in site selection reviews and work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements
• Critical Data Center equipment design including site-wide MV infrastructure, Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supplies, Switchgear, Transformers and Earthing
• Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements
• Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate electrical equipment
• Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with IEC requirements, the various APAC wide design codes and other jurisdictional requirements
• Review and approval of equipment submittals and ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases
• Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems
• Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
Amazon's Network Control Center (NCC) owns real-time observability, situational awareness, and coordinated intervention across the network to rapidly detect and eliminate issues before the customer journey is degraded.

The Real-Time Remedies Execution (RTRE) function within NCC acts as the centralized communications liaison between Amazon's Recovery teams, Business teams, and Amazon's customers. The mission is to help prevent contacts to Amazon by executing bulk actions on accounts and communications to customers impacted by large-scale issues. RTRE team is responsible for communicating to millions of D2customers each year across more than 20+ languages and owns all bulk actions such as large-scale physical and digital order refunds, cancellations, and more.

Do you want to join a team focused on critical communication and incident recovery, and play a role in the decision-making processes that restore/retain customer trust? Are you a passionate learner willing to relentlessly Deep Dive into data sets and partner with business analysts, advocates across leadership, and business teams? Do you thrive in a culture where Customer Obsession and the Bias For Action are highly valued?

As a Program Specialist, you will play a key role on the team by managing stakeholders on large-scale customer-impacting issues, owning relationships with partner teams, validating data, investigating customer issues, and driving the communications process from creation to execution. You will also contribute to NCC's broader mission of detecting and resolving incidents before customers are impacted, collaborating across multiple teams within the network. You will be detail oriented and results driven to ensure flawless communication execution as well as ensure the needs of both the customers and the business are addressed. Outside of these day-to-day duties, Program Specialists will own and have to work on process improvements.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own and drive bulk recovery action for D2 customers, including data validation, stakeholder coordination, and flawless execution.
2. Publish customer-facing mass communications, independently assessing situations and advocating for the most customer-centric path forward.
3. Manage high-severity incidents by collaborating cross-functionally to mitigate risks to business, customer experience, and associate experience.
4. Serve as the liaison between business analyst teams, product teams, and recovery stakeholders on complex issues requiring data assistance or tooling alignment.
5. Execute high-impact mitigation actions using various tools while performing quality checks to ensure ideal customer outcomes.
6. Plan, prioritize, and deliver team-related projects, balancing day-to-day operations with longer-term improvement initiatives.
7. Identify process improvement opportunities, propose changes, and amend SOPs once approved.


A day in the life
Our team supports customers impacted by issues with Amazon's first-party products and services (Kindle, Echo, Appstore, Prime Video, etc.). We provide critical communications and take proactive actions to resolve their concerns, reducing the need for customers to contact customer service and improving their overall experience.

Program Specialists manage requests related to D2, collaborating one-to-one with requesting teams to identify optimal solutions for business POCs and impacted customers. Work varies daily - from stakeholder management and content creation to data handling. Once approved, specialists use various tools to execute large-scale actions: mass communications, push notifications, refunds, and order cancellations.

description:
Do you want to define and drive the learning strategy for an organization that impacts thousands of associates globally?

As a Site Trainer, you will own the end-to-end training lifecycle — from identifying strategic learning needs to designing scalable programs, mentoring trainers, and measuring business-level impact. You will bring deep expertise in communication training and instructional design to shape how teams develop, perform, and grow. This role goes beyond delivery — you will set the direction, influence stakeholders, and build training frameworks that scale across sites and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
Training Strategy & Program Ownership
• Own and drive the training strategy for assigned programs or business lines, defining learning roadmaps aligned with organizational goals and operational priorities
• Design and implement scalable training frameworks that can be replicated across sites, teams, and geographies
• Identify emerging skill gaps through proactive analysis of business trends, performance data, and stakeholder input; develop strategic interventions without waiting for escalation
• Lead the design and rollout of organization-wide communication excellence programs (business writing, verbal fluency, presentation skills, stakeholder communication)
Advanced Training Delivery & Communication Coaching
• Facilitate high-complexity training sessions including leadership communication workshops, advanced soft skills programs, and cross-functional capability-building initiatives
• Serve as the subject matter expert for communication training — design and deliver modules on accent modification, business communication, customer interaction strategies, and executive communication
• Lead Train-the-Trainer (TTT) programs to build trainer capability across sites; certify and calibrate trainers on delivery standards
• Design and facilitate simulations, role-plays, and scenario-based learning for complex, ambiguous situations
Curriculum Design & Innovation
• Architect comprehensive curricula using advanced instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning Design) with emphasis on scalability and learner experience
• Pioneer innovative learning formats (microlearning, gamification, AI-assisted content, peer learning communities) to drive engagement and retention
• Establish content governance standards — version control, review cadence, and retirement criteria for training materials
• Design multi-level assessment frameworks including competency-based evaluations, capstone projects, and certification pathways
Data-Driven Training Effectiveness & Impact
• Define and own training effectiveness metrics across the full Kirkpatrick model (Levels 1-4); establish causal links between training programs and business outcomes
• Build and maintain executive-level dashboards that communicate training ROI, learner progression, and capability development trends
• Conduct deep-dive analyses on underperforming programs; develop and execute improvement action plans with measurable targets
• Benchmark training programs against industry standards and internal best practices; drive continuous improvement through data
Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership
• Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Quality, WFM, and HR to align training investments with business strategy
• Represent training in business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs) — present insights, advocate for learning initiatives, and influence resource allocation decisions
• Mentor and develop Training Specialists; provide structured coaching, feedback, and career development guidance
• Drive cross-site standardization of training practices while adapting for local context and needs

A day in the life
Your morning may begin with a strategy session with operations leadership, aligning training priorities with upcoming business goals and identifying capability gaps across multiple programs. You then review training effectiveness data across sites, spotting trends and crafting recommendations for program redesign. Mid-day, you mentor a team of trainers on advanced facilitation techniques and provide feedback on their curriculum designs. In the afternoon, you lead a cross-functional working group to launch a new communication excellence program, defining the rollout plan, success metrics, and stakeholder communication strategy. You close the day by presenting quarterly training impact analysis to senior leadership, demonstrating how your programs drove measurable improvements in quality scores and operational KPIs.

About the team
The Training team is dedicated to accelerating specialist readiness and continuous development at scale. We partner closely with Operations, Quality, and Workforce Management across multiple sites and geographies to deliver learning solutions that drive performance outcomes. Our vision is to build a culture of continuous learning where every specialist has the skills and confidence to deliver world-class service. As a Site Trainer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping team strategy, mentoring junior trainers, and raising the bar for learning programs across the organization.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


Key job responsibilities
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.

You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.

As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).

A day in the life
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.

About the team
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.

description:
Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of data center cooling through advanced CFD analysis and innovative mechanical system design? Do you want to own the technical direction of CFD modeling standards across a global engineering organization? Are you ready to lead the development of thermal solutions that directly influence how we scale our infrastructure worldwide?

In this role you will own the end-to-end CFD modeling strategy for complex mechanical systems — from internal data hall thermal analysis to campus-wide external wind and contaminant dispersion studies. You will define methodologies and standards that scale globally, lead the development of innovative cooling solutions, and serve as the technical authority for thermal performance across the organization. As the subject matter expert, you will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.


Key job responsibilities
CFD Modeling & Technical Leadership

● Defining the CFD modeling approach for innovative data center designs; developing validation methodologies and establishing best practices for the broader engineering team
● Leading internal CFD studies for data halls and electrical rooms, including steady-state thermal analysis under N unit failure scenarios and N+1 operational conditions at full load
● Performing transient thermal studies to assess IT equipment survivability during concurrent power failure and unit failure events, including time-to-recovery analysis post power restoration
● Owning external CFD studies encompassing full campus mechanical and electrical plant, including adjacent industrial complexes and site obstructions, and leading thermal plume recirculation analysis to understand heat dissipating equipment impact on building and equipment intake temperatures
● Performing air emissions and contaminant dispersion modeling to quantify generator exhaust ingestion into building intakes
● Proposing and validating mitigation strategies where results indicate exceedance of defined limits, and implementing solutions into the CFD model for verification
● Managing external CFD consultants including review and approval of return briefs, model inputs, assumptions, and boundary conditions prior to solving

Mentorship & Team Development

● Providing mentoring, guidance and developing junior engineers in CFD techniques, mechanical design best practices, and professional growth


About the team
The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of data centers. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand.

We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

description:
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

Key job responsibilities
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team


A day in the life
As an Applied Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, collaborating with engineers to deploy computer vision models to production, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

The IPS Procurement Category Management Org is responsible for the procurement of all third party provided services required for the operation of our Data Center infrastructure globally, including Colo and Edge facilities for externally delivered services not provided by the facility owner. The team is responsible for the identification, on boarding and performance management of suppliers as well as developing category strategies, conducting competitive tendering processes, supplier negotiations and the preparation of associated Work Orders.

The team is structured into three regions, each led by a regional manager, with each regional team composed of category managers with responsibility for the management of specific areas of spend within the region and a cohort of procurement specialists who support the category managers. The category management approach facilitates a strategic approach to procurement by facilitating in depth market analysis coupled with a cross functional approach to identify supplier and associated contracting options which are focused on meeting the particular needs of the business. Category management moves beyond traditional transactional based purchasing negotiations to provide a strategic approach to longer term, sustainable cost reductions, reducing risk and increasing resiliency in the supply base and facilitating innovation from within the supply base that the business can leverage.
While cost reduction will always be a key focus of the team, the principle cynosure of the team is the delivery of services that are keenly focused on increasing reliability and supporting enhanced availability through robust relationships which support continuity of operations. As service and quality levels can vary greatly, principally based on the skill set within a supplier local organization, the regional structure facilitates tailoring of category strategies to meet local market considerations and closely monitor supplier performance at the local level.


Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

•Manage a complex category within the Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) and Facility Management domains.

•Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations, drive collaboration to achieve long term value delivery.

•Obtain market intelligence, analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies.

•Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns, across categories and regions, to influence customers’ priorities.

•Lead supplier selection process across multiple sub-categories, internal teams, and regions, and create longer-term supplier selection strategies for management.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about the supply market, new innovations and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about sustainability, diversity, in-country value and have experience developing category strategies to incorporate same.

•Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost.

•Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance.

•Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships.

•Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle.

•Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as SRM and management of contracts post-execution.

Travel domestic and international as required.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
Drive transformative technical programs that solve complex retail challenges by bridging science, data engineering, and business operations at Amazon scale. You'll own end-to-end delivery of ML/AI-powered solutions that impact billions in gross merchandise sales and hundreds of millions of customers worldwide, while collaborating with Applied Science, Data Engineering, Finance, and Retail leadership across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
Lead end-to-end technical program delivery across ML/AI development, data pipeline architecture, and science-driven solutions that address critical retail challenges including catalog enrichment, defect root-cause analysis, cost allocation, and profitability modeling

Partner across retail organizations to identify customer problems, define technical solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in collaboration with Selection, Supply Chain, Category, and Marketplace teams

Serve as technical liaison between Applied Science, Data Engineering, and Business teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications and ensuring models are production-ready for scale

Drive architecture and system design discussions that evaluate trade-offs and ensure solutions support scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency across large-scale retail operations

Manage cross-functional dependencies and competing priorities across Science, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Retail organizations, driving alignment at executive leadership levels and implementing risk mitigations

A day in the life
As a Senior Technical Program Manager in Retail Business Services, you'll navigate the intersection of machine learning innovation and retail operations. Your day might include facilitating a design discussion with our Applied Science team to evaluate trade-offs in a new catalog enrichment model, then pivoting to align cross-functional stakeholders on data pipeline architecture for supply chain defect elimination. You'll translate complex technical requirements into clear specifications, work with Data Engineering to ensure models are production-ready, and build measurement frameworks that quantify business impact. Our mission is to ensure that Amazon's catalog is complete, correct, and comprehensive—enabling customers to find exactly what they need every time. We work at the intersection of science, data, and retail business, tackling challenges that span catalog quality, inventory optimization, cost allocation, and supply chain efficiency.

Our team collaborates closely with Applied Science, Data Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Retail organizations worldwide. We operate with visibility into senior leadership forums, giving us the opportunity to influence strategy at the highest levels. We're looking for someone who thrives in this complex, multi-stakeholder environment and can translate ambiguous problems into clear technical solutions. If you're energized by working on problems that impact billions of dollars in business value and hundreds of millions of customers, this is the place for you.

description:
Are you interested in building a high-performance, globally scalable gross-to-net payroll calculation engine with deep tax calculation capabilities that supports Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring accurate financial calculations that directly impact employees? This is the job for you.

Amazon's Payroll Tax & Accounting Technology team is looking for a results-oriented, driven Software Development Engineer who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable gross-to-net calculation infrastructure with sophisticated tax processing at its core. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex regulatory contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. We need someone to design and develop a single global system that processes gross earnings through complex multi-jurisdiction tax calculations to net pay for millions of employees, with local configuration driven by LLM-based rule extraction.

A Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Amazon works on real world problems on a global scale, owns their systems end to end and influences the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions of customers around the world. You can expect to design flexible and scalable solutions, and work on some of the most complex challenges in large-scale computing by utilizing your skills in data structures, algorithms, and object oriented programming. Coming to Amazon gives you the opportunity to work on a small development team in one of our many rapidly growing organizations.

You will learn all about how to design, implement and test highly scalable solutions using AWS cloud platform and its many products, in challenging agile projects, working with best in class professionals.

In this role you will:

- Build a globally deployed, locally configured gross-to-net calculation engine that leverages LLM-based rule extraction to formalize complex jurisdiction-specific tax regulations, including multi-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and statutory compliance requirements
- Design and develop deterministic tax calculation algorithms that handle employee withholding, employer tax obligations, and process gross earnings through deductions to calculate net pay across multiple countries
- Create accounting integration services that generate GL entries and journal entries for all necessary payroll entries, like earnings, tax, & benefits
- Implement GenAI shadow mode validation frameworks to ensure accuracy against existing systems
- Partner directly with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Technical Program Managers, tax specialists, and payroll operations teams to understand features and continuously identify opportunities to build and deploy software solutions

Key job responsibilities
- Define high-level and low-level design for the global gross-to-net calculation engine with complex tax processing capabilities using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment
- Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices for deterministic financial calculations and using data to define and improve operational best practices
- Help drive the architecture and technology choices for the LLM-based rule extraction pipeline and tax-centric gross-to-net calculation products
- Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon's global payroll tax calculation and gross-to-net accounting needs
- Raise the bar on code quality, including security, auditability, readability, consistency, and maintainability
- Leverage GenAI capabilities to build validation frameworks and continuously improve system accuracy

A day in the life
You'll start your morning collaborating with tax specialists and payroll operations teams across multiple countries to understand jurisdiction-specific requirements. Mid-day, you'll design and code deterministic tax calculation algorithms, leveraging LLM-based rule extraction to formalize complex regulations into executable logic. You'll investigate how different countries structure their tax codes, exploring edge cases and regulatory nuances. Afternoons involve implementing shadow mode validation frameworks, reviewing code with your team, and refining accounting integrations. You'll tackle challenges like handling multi-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and ensuring sub-millisecond performance while maintaining 100% statutory compliance for millions of employees globally.

description:
Amazon Advertising is one of the fastest-growing business units at Amazon, operating at the intersection of e-commerce and advertising. Amazon DSP (Demand-Side Platform) enables advertisers to programmatically buy display, video, and audio ads both on and off Amazon properties, helping them reach relevant audiences across the open web and Amazon-owned inventory. We believe that advertising, when done well, enhances the customer experience and generates positive ROI for our advertising partners.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a Biz Tech Leader to own and scale the Amazon DSP business in India. This is a high-impact role that combines technology, business development, and revenue growth. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in digital advertising and programmatic ecosystems, with a proven track record of building and scaling ad-tech businesses. You will own the P&L for your product area, drive publisher supply acquisition, demand strategies, and partner closely with product, engineering, and frontline sales teams to build differentiated capabilities for the India market.
You will work with a dedicated product and engineering team and collaborate extensively with WW Ads, India Sales & Account Management, and cross-functional stakeholders. You will be responsible for establishing key metrics, setting and meeting goals on business/product metrics, advertiser engagement, publisher partnerships, and revenue growth. You will drive key business and CX metrics including advertising revenue, DSP utilization, fill rates, yield optimization, and ad relevance.

● Revenue & P&L Ownership: Own the Amazon DSP India revenue targets. Define and execute strategies to grow programmatic advertising revenue across display and video ad formats.
● Publisher Supply & Business Development: Lead publisher acquisition strategy for the India market. Build and scale relationships with premium publishers to expand inventory supply on the Amazon DSP network.
● Demand Generation: Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Marketing teams to drive advertiser adoption of Amazon DSP. Develop go-to-market strategies for new ad products and formats.
● Programmatic Strategy: Define the India DSP product and business roadmap leveraging deep understanding of programmatic buying, real-time bidding (RTB), private marketplaces (PMP), and programmatic guaranteed deals.
● Ad Format Innovation: Drive adoption and growth of display, video, audio, and emerging ad formats. Identify market-specific opportunities for India.
● Technology & Product Partnership: Collaborate with product management and engineering teams to influence the product roadmap, prioritize India-specific feature development, and ensure technical capabilities align with business growth aspirations.
● Metrics & Analytics: Establish and monitor key performance indicators including fill rate, eCPM, revenue yield, advertiser ROAS, omnichannel, publisher monetization, and campaign delivery metrics.
● Stakeholder Management: Engage with WW Ads leadership, India Ads leadership, Demand teams, and external partners to align on strategy and execution.

About the team
The Amazon DSP India team's north star is to make Amazon DSP the partner of choice for customers seeking to achieve their performance marketing and branding objectives. We operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where we continuously build and enhance product capabilities to improve shopper engagement and advertiser experience. The team works on programmatic advertising, combining Amazon's unique audience insights with world-class ad-tech infrastructure to deliver measurable outcomes for advertisers and publishers alike.

description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support.

The Financial Services Industry (FSI) team at AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect to work with our enterprise banking, insurance, capital markets, and fintech customers. You will help India's leading financial institutions leverage AWS to modernize their technology landscape, build innovative digital products, drive cloud-native transformation, and adopt AI/ML and Generative AI to unlock new business value.

As a Solutions Architect, you will own the technical engagement and success of specific customer projects, develop deep expertise in AWS technologies, and understand how applications and services are constructed on the AWS platform. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs, CIOs, and engineering leaders at India's most prominent financial services organizations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the technical relationship with assigned FSI customers, acting as their trusted cloud advisor and driving architectural best practices across their AWS journey.

Design and architect scalable, secure, and cost-optimized cloud solutions for banking core modernization, payments infrastructure, insurance platforms, and capital markets workloads.

Conduct Well-Architected Reviews and provide actionable recommendations across reliability, security, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and operational excellence pillars.

Build and deliver Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and technical demonstrations to validate architectural approaches, accelerate customer decision-making, and remove technical blockers.

Guide customers on adopting Generative AI and AI/ML services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend) for use cases such as document processing, fraud detection, customer engagement, and risk analytics.

Partner with AWS Specialist teams (Analytics, Security, Migration, Containers, Serverless) to implement end-to-end solutions addressing complex multi-domain requirements.

Advise on cloud migration and modernization strategies including re-platforming legacy on-premises workloads, containerization, serverless adoption, and data platform modernization.

Present architecture patterns, best practices, and case studies to customer technical communities, C-Suite executives, and at AWS events/summits.

Identify repeatable patterns, contribute to internal knowledge repositories, and author customer-facing content such as reference architectures and whitepapers.

Collaborate with Account Managers and customer success teams to drive workload adoption, revenue growth, and long-term customer satisfaction.

About the team
The FSI Solutions Architecture team at AWS India serves some of the country's largest and most innovative financial institutions. Our team is geographically distributed across Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, and Gurugram, working closely with enterprise customers on their most critical technology transformation initiatives.

We operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer obsession. Our Solutions Architects are hands-on builders who design and validate architectures, engage with CxO-level stakeholders, and drive measurable business outcomes. The team culture values intellectual curiosity, ownership, bias for action, and a relentless focus on earning customer trust.

description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-savvy Business Analyst to join our Supply Chain SSD team. In this role, you will be the analytical engine behind decisions impacting SSD business, the tip of the speed spear.
You will partner closely with Program Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to identify inefficiencies, surface insights from large and complex datasets, and translate them into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes data, has strong SQL chops, can build dashboards that tell a story, and brings sharp business acumen to identify and solve hard, ambiguous problems. We are looking for a hands-on operator - someone who does not wait for clean data or perfect requirements, but rolls up their sleeves, digs into the problem, and drives it to closure.

∙ Deep-dive analytics: Independently scope, design, and execute complex analyses on inventory placement, network flow, regional demand patterns, fill rates, and outbound shipping cost drivers. Translate raw data into clear, actionable business insights.
∙ Dashboard and reporting ownership: Build, automate, and maintain self-serve dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) that give stakeholders real-time visibility into key placement, inventory health, and network performance metrics.
∙ SQL and data engineering: Write efficient, production-grade SQL on large datasets (Redshift, Hive, Athena). Build and maintain ETL pipelines, data marts, and reusable datasets that scale across the team.
∙ Problem identification: Proactively find gaps, anomalies, and improvement opportunities in placement logic, replenishment patterns, and inventory positioning — often before stakeholders ask. Frame these as business problems with quantified impact.

∙ Stakeholder communication: Present findings to senior leadership in crisp, data-backed narratives — both written documents and verbal reviews. Influence decisions without authority.
∙ Tooling and automation: Identify manual, repetitive workflows and automate them using SQL, Python, or scripting. Continuously raise the bar on team productivity.

description:
Amazon Now is India's fastest-growing Quick Commerce offering, delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We are on a mission to expand to 300+ cities and become the most loved quick commerce destination for millions of customers. To achieve this, we are building world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless under-the-roof operations across our partner network.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Software Development Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team that owns the technology powering store operations and grocery partner experiences. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you will build systems that directly fuel Amazon's rapid Quick Commerce expansion — a flagship S-Team goal.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end technology stack for store launches, enabling rapid onboarding of new partner stores across cities at unprecedented speed and scale
2. Build and evolve catalog and selection management systems — curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the seller experience for listing new items
3. Drive Under-the-Roof (UTR) technology — powering inventory management, picking, staging, and store operations workflows
4. Lead architecture decisions for systems that must scale reliably across hundreds of stores while maintaining sub-minute operational latencies
5. Recruit, mentor, and grow a team of SDEs fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and operational excellence
6. Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous business problems into crisp technical solutions
7. Establish engineering best practices, drive operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), and maintain a high quality bar

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing key operational metrics and ensuring systems are healthy across all live stores. You join a standup with your team to unblock engineers, review design documents, and prioritize the sprint backlog. Mid-morning, you collaborate with product and operations partners to define requirements for the next wave of store launches. After lunch, you dive into a system design review for a new catalog ingestion pipeline, providing technical guidance and challenging assumptions. Later, you conduct a 1:1 with a team member to discuss career growth and align on stretch goals. You wrap up by reviewing a deployment plan for a feature that will go live across multiple cities this week — ensuring rollback strategies and monitoring are in place.

About the team
We are part of Amazon Now (Tez), Amazon's Quick Commerce business in India. Our team builds the technology that powers how partner stores operate — from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving complex problems in real-time inventory management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work directly impacts millions of customers who rely on us for their everyday essentials delivered in minutes.

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. Our team puts a high value on work-life balance and offers flexibility in working hours. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor.

description:
What if you could talk to your Amazon Store? With Alexa+ on Echo Show, customers can now do exactly that. The full Amazon store is live on Echo Show 15 and 21 — a new way to shop at home that combines voice as a natural way to express needs with the product details, reviews, and videos customers rely on to make confident decisions.

This product started with an ambitious question and was built from scratch — no prior version to iterate on, no existing architecture to extend, no playbook to follow. The team pioneered novel challenges including rendering the full, always-current Amazon store natively on Echo Show in real time, building visual grounding from scratch so Alexa's responses stay anchored to what the customer sees on screen, and creating a conversational commerce paradigm that lets customers skip screens entirely with natural language.

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to help build the next chapter of this experience — scaling what we've built, expanding to new surfaces and marketplaces, and pushing the boundaries of agentic, multimodal shopping. As an early-career engineer on this team, you'll design and build meaningful components alongside experienced engineers, own your work through design, implementation, testing, and livesite, and grow quickly in a high-ownership environment.

This is greenfield, 0→1 work at the intersection of Generative AI, multimodal experiences, and conversational commerce. You will have the freedom to experiment, learn, and invent on behalf of our customers, and you'll work for a strong leadership team that optimizes for your growth and pairs you with mentors who will guide your career.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer I on this team, you will:

- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.

- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.

- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.

- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.

- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.

- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.

- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

A day in the life
Here's what a typical day might look like. You'll spend meaningful time building — designing and implementing features that scale the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices, whether that's improving how the store renders in real time, sharpening visual grounding, or extending the experience to a new marketplace. You'll write code, review your teammates', and get thoughtful feedback on yours.

Days blend focused coding with a short standup, design conversations where your ideas are genuinely wanted, and pairing with a senior engineer or mentor when you're working through something ambiguous. Because this is 0→1 work, you'll often be making decisions without a playbook — and that's the fun part. You'll partner closely with engineering, science, product, and design colleagues across Alexa Shopping, many of them in Seattle, so some collaboration spans time zones.

Your internal stakeholders are the product, design, and partner engineering teams shaping the Alexa+ shopping experience; your end customers are shoppers at home talking to their Echo Show, expecting it to just work. The problems you'll tackle range from "how do we keep the store always in sync and fast on-device?" to "how do we make a conversational shopping flow feel effortless?" — meaty, customer-facing problems where what you build lands in people's living rooms.

About the team
We're the team that taught the Amazon Store to talk back. We took an idea that didn't have a blueprint and shipped it to customers' living rooms — and now we're just getting to the fun part: making it bigger, faster, and available to shoppers around the world.

Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make shopping on Alexa feel effortless and delightful, no matter where a customer is or which device they reach for. We sit right where voice, vision, and Generative AI meet retail at Amazon scale — which means the problems we solve genuinely haven't been solved before, and the person who cracks them is often the newest engineer with a fresh idea.

Culture-wise, we're builders who like ambiguity and dislike bureaucracy. We ship, we learn, we tell stories over chai, and we celebrate the wins (and the instructive failures). We hire smart people and give them room to run — you'll own real problems from day one, with experienced engineers and mentors in your corner, not looking over your shoulder. We take the work seriously and ourselves a little less so. If you like the idea of building something customers can literally talk to, you'll fit right in.

description:
Amazon seeks a results-oriented, analytical Process Improvement Specialist to join the EU FBA Support Operations team. This role sits within our Seller Experience & Insights pillar, focused on reducing escalation volume through rigorous root cause analysis, process improvement design, and cross-functional coordination. You will own the analytical backbone of our escalation reduction program — investigating why escalations occur, designing the fixes, and measuring their impact.
This is a hands-on, high-depth role. You will deep-dive into escalation data, map operational processes, identify systemic failure points, write structured root cause analyses, and drive process improvements through to implementation and measured impact. You will work closely with operations teams, product managers, and policy owners to ensure fixes are implemented — not just recommended.



Key job responsibilities
Own root cause analysis (RCA) for escalation themes: investigate patterns across ticket data, map failure points in operational processes, and produce structured RCA write-ups with clear findings, root causes, and recommended fixes.

Build and maintain the escalation reduction roadmap: prioritize systemic issues by seller impact and volume, track progress against reduction targets, and report status weekly.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (product, policy, operations, WW Support Ops) to drive implementation of fixes — ensuring issues have owners, deadlines, and closure criteria
Design SLA frameworks and operational standards for escalation resolution, working with the operations team to define quality and timeliness benchmarks.

Partner with the Voice of Seller specialist to connect escalation RCA findings with broader seller experience trends — turning reactive investigations into proactive prevention
Produce dashboards and reporting that make escalation health, reduction progress, and process performance visible to the team and leadership

Conduct regular Gemba walks and frontline observation sessions with escalation investigators to gather process insights directly — ensuring RCA findings are grounded in operational reality, not just data patterns

A day in the life
You start by reviewing escalation data for patterns and emerging failure modes. You identify a cluster, map the root cause, then validate it through a Gemba session with the operations team. You draft a structured RCA with a recommended fix and align with the product team who owns the system. You work on coaching of analytical methodology and update the escalation reduction dashboard. By Friday, the fix you proposed weeks ago shows up in the metrics — fewer escalations, better seller outcomes.

About the team
Today, more than 60% of worldwide purchases from Amazon are made from third-party selling partners, mostly from small- and medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery, returns, and customer service to Amazon.

description:
Amazon Now is India's fastest-growing quick commerce platform — and the pricing mechanisms that power our last-mile network are built by this team. If you want to own national-scale OTR pricing strategy while acting as the voice of Delivery Partners across a high-velocity network, this role is for you.

As a Program Manager on the Amazon Now OTR Strategy team, you will design and deploy rider rate cards and incentive structures that shape the economics of millions of deliveries across India. You will ensure Delivery Partners have competitive, reliable earnings — making Amazon the number one destination for delivery work in every city we operate in. Our Delivery Partners are the face of Amazon in front of our customers, and this role exists to make sure they are engaged, fairly compensated, and set up to thrive.


Key job responsibilities
OTR Rate Card Design & Deployment: Own end-to-end design and deployment of OTR rate cards and Delivery Partner incentive structures at national scale. Pricing is the lever that moves everything else.

Voice of Delivery Partners: Track earnings competitiveness, identify reliability gaps, and drive interventions that make Amazon the number one destination for delivery work. Our Delivery Partners are the face of Amazon.

Benchmarking: Lead competitor rate card benchmarking at hyper-local granularity and translate field intelligence into actionable pricing recommendations.

Incentive Programs: Design surge pricing and productivity-linked incentive programs that keep Delivery Partners engaged across peak and off-peak cycles.

Pricing Analytics: Build frameworks in SQL/R and Excel to monitor rate card performance, track cost-per-delivery trends, and measure impact of pricing interventions.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with LM Operations, Forecasting, Finance, Product and Capacity Planning teams to ensure pricing decisions are smart, operationally grounded and financially sustainable.

Senior Leadership Reporting: Present data-backed pricing recommendations to senior leadership, distilling complex trade-offs into clear decision points.

A day in the life
Your day typically starts with a quick review of overnight delivery cost metrics and flagging any rate card anomalies across clusters. Mid-morning you might be on a call with a 3P partner discussing IC benchmarking data, or pulling a SQL query to size the earnings gap in a specific city. Afternoons are often cross-functional — aligning with Operations on a surge pricing intervention, walking Finance through CPD impact, or providing pricing inputs for a new product launch. You will spend time in the field periodically, talking to Delivery Partners directly to understand what the data does not always show.

About the team
The Amazon Now OTR Strategy team defines how Delivery Partners are compensated and how pricing mechanisms scale across India's fastest-growing quick commerce network. We are a small, high-ownership team that combines financial rigor with deep operational context — we move fast, learn from data, and hold ourselves accountable to clear outcomes. Our work sits at the intersection of finance, operations, product, and field execution, with direct impact on millions of deliveries every month. If you want ownership, visibility, and the chance to build something at scale — this is the team for you.

description:
As a Sr. Prod Compliance Associate in the ASCI team, you will execute AI model improvement, red teaming, customer feedback triage, and incident monitoring tasks across Alexa experiences. You will apply judgment within established SOPs and use AI tools to support your work across non-sensitive workstreams. You will work alongside AI automation (LLM judges, AI agents) as a human-in-the-loop to ensure quality and safety standards are met. Associates are expected to use AI-powered tools (e.g., LLM assistants, summarizers, pattern analysis tools) as a default in all workstreams except when handling customer-sensitive data, which must follow security protocols in the restricted environment.

Key job responsibilities
1. AI Data Annotation, Quality Auditing & Model Improvement

- Perform multi-domain data annotation and golden dataset curation for AI model improvement, following established SOPs and quality benchmarks
- Validate and audit LLM judge outputs through human-in-the-loop review; use AI tools to flag patterns and anomalies
- Maintain annotation accuracy and audit throughput targets; use AI-assisted error analysis to identify systematic failures and escalate to Process Experts
- Participate in calibration exercises to ensure reviewer consistency and draft audit reports for program leads

2. Red Teaming Execution
- Execute adversarial testing across multiple Alexa experiences (Alexa+, Ring, Automotive, Kids), using AI to generate diverse attack vectors and edge cases
- Identify, document, and categorize policy violations, safety gaps, and vulnerabilities by severity and impact
- Draft red teaming documentation and vulnerability summaries, ensuring findings are clearly categorized for program leads

3. Customer Feedback Triage & Analysis

- Classify and triage daily customer feedback records per SOPs, using AI to pre-sort and surface emerging patterns
- Identify recurring issues, escalation-worthy trends, and edge cases in customer interaction data
- Handle complex cases requiring human judgment alongside AI-automated pre-filtering and routing
- Generate trend summaries and insight reports for program leads

4. Incident Monitoring & Escalation Support

- Monitor for policy violations and emerging issues per established protocols, using AI to track incident patterns across workstreams
- Draft escalation tickets, incident summaries, and root-cause hypotheses to support cross-functional response
- Coordinate with Operations, Engineering, and Science teams to drive timely resolution; escalate complex cases.
- Contribute observations and incident learnings to refine SOPs, tools, and response playbooks

5. Process Improvement & Team Support

- Identify and propose process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, using AI to prototype automation and workflow optimizations
- Draft and maintain SOPs, training materials, and onboarding guides using AI-assisted documentation tools
- Mentor junior associates and peers; share learnings and conduct training sessions
- Contribute to UAT for new tools (LLM judge workflows, AI agent pipelines) and recommend adoption to program leads

A day in the life
You check incident alerts and prioritize escalations, then move into your core work block, validating LLM judge outputs, curating datasets, or reviewing flagged discrepancies for accuracy. You also handle customer feedback triage, managing the ambiguous cases and edge cases that AI pre-sorting can't confidently classify from the day's records. Other responsibilities rotate between red teaming, drafting incident summaries, calibration sessions, or process improvements like updating SOPs and mentoring junior associates. You wrap up by logging throughput and flagging open items for the next shift.

About the team
The ASCI (AI Safety, Compliance & Improvement) Programs & Operations team works at the intersection of AI quality and customer safety across Alexa experiences. Our Model Improvement & RAI CX Ops group is responsible for ensuring AI systems meet safety, accuracy, and policy standards through human-in-the-loop review, red teaming, and feedback analysis. We operate across Alexa+, Ring, Automotive, and Kids experiences, combining human judgment with AI-powered tools to keep pace with rapidly evolving models and customer needs.

APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. WW RR&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and sustainability.

Amazon WW RR&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

Inventory Trust team (SPIV) works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. Our mission is to safeguard our store from bad inventory and bad actors concealing their identities. description:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a proactive and solution-driven professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Expert. In this key role, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives and implement enhanced security measures across your assigned sites, delivering security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive and implement site-level security improvements and process optimization initiatives
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards as well as Amazon global security standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level


A day in the life
As an SLP Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You drive site-level security improvements by identifying trends, analyzing data, and implementing process enhancements. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you proactively develop and implement mitigating measures at the site level. You play a key role in maintaining and improving the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Worldwide Operations Security organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:
• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation
Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running.
